default.notes: Props, children and explicit bindings form the executable rendering contract.

ReaderBase.notes: The Host composes the live reader from Core content, ReaderUIRuntime state, persisted appearance and measured layout. Canonical children are anatomy evidence and must not be recursively duplicated.

ReadingBackgroundLayer.notes: The live theme is resolved by the Host appearance store; fixture theme values are design-state evidence only.

ReadingTextFlow.notes: Core owns content identity and blocks; the Host owns pagination and layout measurements.

ReadingInfoLayer.notes: Canonical location comes from Core while display progress and session projection are derived by ReaderUIRuntime.

TapZones.notes: ReaderUIRuntime owns event intent; the Host gates it using measured pagination mode and current boundaries.

ReaderTopArea.notes: Book/source identity, overlay state and appearance are projected into one native top area.

ReaderBottomBar.notes: Module selection and overlay state are runtime-owned and rendered as one native control surface.
